item.description:

The 23-year-old American revealed levels to his game heretofore unseen, over the course of a U.S. Open quarterfinal that technically began Tuesday night but was mostly played early Wednesday morning. In the great tradition of 21st-century American men's tennis players, Shelton's key weapon is his serve, which he hits not just with peerless top-end speed (he reached 149 mph in this match) but also a rich variety of spin and location. item.title: Republicans put Trump center stage in US midterms gamble
item.description:
Is Donald Trump trying to help Republicans win the midterm elections? The obvious answer to this question is yes, of course , simply because all political leaders benefit from their party winning elections. Yet several of Trump’s actions throw this normally perfunctory question into at least some doubt. Traditionally, candidates laboring under the burden of an unpopular president seek to detach themselves from the national brand. Trump is making this impossible. He has launched a national ad campaign focused on himself, and thrown a high-profile “midterm convention” designed to further reinforce the synonymity of the party and its leader. Trump has also made several remarks that convey an emotional detachment from the election’s outcome—comments such as “I’m not affected by the election” or “I don’t care about the midterms.” Perhaps he is merely feigning indifference. item.title: US bond yields spike after Bessent increases buybacks
item.description:
US long-term bond yields spiked to three-year highs Wednesday after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s bond buybacks failed to impress markets. Borrowing costs leapt higher in part because investors expected more firepower, a Deutsche Bank strategist told Bloomberg: “It’s like Treasury created this monster that it now has to keep feeding.” Bessent’s smaller-than-expected move suggests he’s accepted a “limited role” for buybacks, Evercore ISI analysts wrote, which aren’t likely to reverse yields without addressing the “direction of the debt and deficit,” a Société Générale researcher said. “ Everything else is cosmetic .” Bessent is juggling multiple interventions, daring traders to take the opposite side of his yen purchases. “I have asymmetric information. I am the house now ,” he said Tuesday. — Brendan Ruberry

Saudi had vowed to retaliate after the Houthis carried out their largest attack on the kingdom since a 2022 ceasefire , injuring 73 people and disrupting oil production.
